name: SD Guthrie Berhad
overview: 2026年，SD Guthrie 继续以种植与棕油加工为主业，同时通过 SD Guthrie Land Ventures 与多方成立合资公司，将柔佛和森美兰的多幅永久地契土地出售给工业/产业园区开发方，并认购合资公司股权。年内还完成了一项土地出售给 Sime Darby Property (Kulai) 的交易，并解散了一家全资子公司。
overview_en: In 2026, SD Guthrie continued to focus on plantation and palm oil processing while, through SD Guthrie Land Ventures, forming joint ventures with several parties to dispose of freehold land in Johor and Negeri Sembilan to industrial/property park developers and subscribe for equity in the JV companies. During the year, it also completed a land disposal to Sime Darby Property (Kulai) and dissolved a wholly-owned subsidiary.

segments.name: 种植业务
segments.note: 持续进行油棕、橡胶、椰子及甘蔗园丘的开发、种植与管理，并按月及按季披露鲜果串、棕油和棕仁产量。
segments.note_en: Continues development, cultivation and management of oil palm, rubber, coconut and sugarcane estates, with monthly and quarterly disclosure of FFB, CPO and PK production.
